metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: Pulp Fiction
metas.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: Mahavatar Narsimha
metas.description: The demon Hiranyakashyap seeks revenge on Vishnu and declares himself a god. His son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu. Vishnu manifests as Narsimha to defeat the demon and restore balance.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.

metas.name: Sonar Kella
metas.description: A young boy becomes a target for crooks, after he claims to remember his past life and mentions precious jewels in a golden fortress.

metas.name: Alai Payuthey
metas.description: After a difficult romance in a class-divided society, the love birds find out marriage is not what they thought it would be.

metas.name: Premam
metas.description: A young man has three opportunities to find love. Will the third time be the charm?

metas.name: Tourist Family
metas.description: A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: Seven years after burying a dark secret, a cinema owner and his family face a renewed investigation led by a relentless new inspector and a grieving mother. New witnesses and forensic traps threaten to shatter their peaceful life.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Kaththi
metas.description: A case of mistaken identity embroils an escaped convict in a fight against a large corporation intent on seizing a village's land.

metas.name: Nayattu
metas.description: Three police officers who are on a run for life, escaping the outbreak against them due to the unlawful arrest and torture of a civilian. It brings in a few shades of arrogant yet very much human police officers and their helpless...

metas.name: Indian
metas.description: A veteran freedom fighter enraged with the rising crime and corruption in the society murders all the wrong doers one by one using an ancient martial arts technique.

metas.name: Vedam
metas.description: Stories of 5 people, an educated slum dweller, an aspiring rock star, an old villager, a prostitute and an ostracized Muslim man; all lead up to a night in a hospital filled with jeopardy.

metas.name: Khushi
metas.description: While playing matchmaker to a pair of their friends, two young university students begin developing feelings for each other.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Malik
metas.description: A past ridden with crime, death and pain is recounted to Freddy, a juvenile criminal, who has been assigned to eliminate his estranged uncle Sulaiman, an aging patriarch, while behind bars.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A young aristocrat falls in love with a poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

metas.name: Rosemary's Baby
metas.description: A young woman suspects her neighbors have sinister plans for her pregnancy.

metas.name: Friends
metas.description: Three friends, who value friendship over everything else, begin to fall apart when one of them learns about a shocking incident that happened in their past.

metas.name: Life of Pi
metas.description: A young man who survives a disaster at sea is hurtled into an epic journey of adventure and discovery. While cast away, he forms an unexpected connection with another survivor: a fearsome Bengal tiger.

metas.name: Gully Boy
metas.description: A coming-of-age story based on the lives of street rappers in Mumbai.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description: A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: Ab Tak Chhappan
metas.description: Sadhu, an encounter specialist, is armed with a personal vendetta to find and kill the gangsters responsible for his wife's death.

metas.name: Hanu Man
metas.description: An imaginary place called Anjanadri where the protagonist gets the powers of Hanuman and fights for Anjanadri.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Piku
metas.description: A quirky comedy about the relationship between a daughter and her aging father, whose eccentricities drive everyone crazy.

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: Temper
metas.description: Daya, a corrupt police officer, finds his life changing when he takes on a case of gang rape.

metas.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: Sitaare Zameen Par
metas.description: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train Neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: Straight from the Heart
metas.description: Nandini has to choose between Sameer, the man who taught her to fall in love; and Vanraj, the man from whom she learnt how to abide and fulfill promises of love.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
metas.description: Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: Gold
metas.description: The journey of a man who was instrumental in making India win its first Olympic gold medal as a free nation.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz
metas.description: A newly married couple's life falls in jeopardy when the wife goes missing under mysterious circumstances.

metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: Sultan
metas.description: Sultan is a classic underdog tale about a wrestler's journey, looking for a comeback by defeating all odds.

metas.name: I Am Kathalan
metas.description: A college student decides to hack into the security system of a company owned by his ex-girlfriend's father.

metas.name: Dressed to Kill
metas.description: A mysterious blonde woman kills one of the patients of a psychiatrist and then goes after the high-class hooker who witnessed the murder.

metas.name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
metas.description: Brooklyn plumbers Mario and Luigi are warped to the magical Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario must team up with Princess Peach, Toad, and Donkey Kong to save Luigi from the evil Bowser.
